panel.length: <int> Horizontal dimension of the rectangular panel to be cut.
panel.width: <int> Vertical dimension of the rectangular panel to be cut.

n: <int> Number of distinct item types that may be cut from the panel.
n_tilde: <int> Total number of item copies across all item types.
rho: <float> Ratio of the largest panel dimension to the largest item dimension.

items.id: <int> Unique identifier for this item type.
items.length: <int> Horizontal dimension of this item type.
items.width: <int> Vertical dimension of this item type.
items.profit: <int> Profit earned for each copy of this item type that is cut from the panel.
items.copies: <int> Maximum number of copies of this item type that may be cut.
